```{r}
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(jsonlite)
library(here)

items <- if (file.exists(here("data", "clean", "items_distributed.csv"))) {
  read_csv(here("data", "clean", "items_distributed.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
} else {
  tibble(school_name = character(), project_date = character(), item_key = character(),
         item_label = character(), group = character(), quantity = numeric())
}

schools <- read_csv(here("data", "clean", "schools.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

# ── Reach: cumulative number of schools served over time ──────────────
# Once EPI starts in a school it never leaves, so the count is cumulative
# by "EPI Start Year". Runs from the earliest start year to the current year.
start_years <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(schools[["EPI Start Year"]]))
start_years <- start_years[!is.na(start_years)]
this_year <- as.integer(format(Sys.Date(), "%Y"))
reach_years  <- if (length(start_years) > 0) seq(min(start_years), max(max(start_years), this_year)) else integer(0)
reach_counts <- vapply(reach_years, function(y) sum(start_years <= y), integer(1))
reach_json   <- toJSON(list(years = reach_years, counts = reach_counts), auto_unbox = TRUE)
n_schools    <- nrow(schools)
first_year   <- if (length(start_years) > 0) min(start_years) else 2008

# Program flags per school (for the "% of schools with each program" bars)
programs_json <- schools |>
  transmute(
    MGR, `Non-Generating MGR`, `Feminine Hygiene Kits`, `Science Kits`,
    Library, Computer, `Construction Projects`, Boreholes,
    `Solar Power`, `Biofill Toilets`, `Light a Village`, Starlink, `GROW Project`
  ) |>
  toJSON(na = "null")

# Date range default for Outputs: current school year (Aug 1 – Jul 31)
school_year_start <- if (as.integer(format(Sys.Date(), "%m")) >= 8) {
  paste0(format(Sys.Date(), "%Y"), "-08-01")
} else {
  paste0(as.integer(format(Sys.Date(), "%Y")) - 1, "-08-01")
}
date_min <- school_year_start
date_max <- as.character(Sys.Date())

items_json_data <- items |>
  transmute(
    school_name,
    project_date = as.character(project_date),
    item_key, item_label, group,
    quantity = as.numeric(quantity)
  )
items_json <- toJSON(items_json_data, auto_unbox = TRUE, na = "null")
```

#| echo: false
htmltools::HTML(paste0(
'<style>
.output-tile:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.14) !important; }
</style>

<!-- ── Outputs ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── -->
<h3 style="color:var(--epi-navy); font-size:1.15rem; margin:0.25rem 0 0.75rem;">Outputs</h3>
<p style="color:#666; font-size:0.9rem; margin-bottom:1rem;">EPI program outputs during the selected date range.</p>

<div style="background:#fff; border-radius:8px; padding:1rem 1.5rem; box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); margin-bottom:1.5rem; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:1rem; flex-wrap:wrap; justify-content:center;">
  <label style="font-weight:600; color:var(--epi-navy); font-size:0.9rem;">Date Range:</label>
  <input type="date" id="imp-date-start" value="', date_min, '" style="border:1px solid #ccc; border-radius:4px; padding:0.35rem 0.5rem; font-size:0.85rem;">
  <span style="color:#999;">to</span>
  <input type="date" id="imp-date-end" value="', date_max, '" style="border:1px solid #ccc; border-radius:4px; padding:0.35rem 0.5rem; font-size:0.85rem;">
  <button id="btn-imp-apply" style="background:var(--epi-navy); color:#fff; border:none; border-radius:4px; padding:0.4rem 1rem; font-size:0.85rem; cursor:pointer; font-weight:600;">Apply</button>
  <button id="btn-imp-reset" style="background:#e9ecef; color:#333; border:none; border-radius:4px; padding:0.4rem 1rem; font-size:0.85rem; cursor:pointer;">Reset</button>
</div>

<div id="impact-empty" style="display:none; background:#fff; border-radius:8px; padding:1.5rem; box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);"><p style="color:#999; font-style:italic; margin:0;">No items recorded in this date range.</p></div>

<div id="outputs-container" style="margin-bottom:2rem;"></div>

<!-- Output detail modal -->
<div id="output-modal" onclick="if(event.target===this)closeOutputModal()" style="display:none; position:fixed; top:0; left:0; width:100%; height:100%; background:rgba(0,0,0,0.5); z-index:9999; align-items:center; justify-content:center;">
  <div style="background:#fff; border-radius:12px; padding:1.5rem 1.75rem; max-width:460px; width:90%; max-height:80vh; overflow:auto; box-shadow:0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);">
    <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:flex-start; gap:1rem;">
      <h3 id="output-modal-title" style="color:var(--epi-navy); margin:0 0 0.25rem;"></h3>
      <button onclick="closeOutputModal()" style="background:none; border:none; font-size:1.6rem; line-height:1; color:#999; cursor:pointer;">&times;</button>
    </div>
    <p id="output-modal-sub" style="color:#999; font-size:0.85rem; margin:0 0 1rem;"></p>
    <div id="output-modal-list"></div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ── Reach ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── -->
<h3 style="color:var(--epi-navy); font-size:1.15rem; margin:0.5rem 0 0.9rem;">Reach</h3>
<div style="background:#fff; border-radius:8px; padding:1.5rem; box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); margin-bottom:1.5rem;">
  <p style="color:var(--epi-navy); font-size:1.15rem; margin:0 0 1rem; font-weight:500;">Since ', first_year, ', EPI has expanded to <strong style="color:#2563EB; font-size:1.45rem;">', n_schools, '</strong> schools</p>
  <div style="position:relative; height:280px;"><canvas id="reach-chart"></canvas></div>
</div>
<div style="background:#fff; border-radius:8px; padding:1.5rem; box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); margin-bottom:2rem;">
  <p style="color:var(--epi-navy); font-size:1.15rem; margin:0 0 1.1rem; font-weight:500;">% of schools with each program</p>
  <div id="program-bars"></div>
</div>

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.0/dist/chart.umd.min.js"></script>
<script>
var ITEMS = ', items_json, ';
var REACH = ', reach_json, ';
var PROGRAMS = ', programs_json, ';

// Outputs grouped into the three EPI program areas (matches empowerplaygrounds.org),
// each with an accent color. Solar Panels -> Providing Light; Biofil Toilets -> Wellness.
var CATEGORIES = [
  { name: "Providing Light", color: "#F5B800", bg: "#FFF8E6",
    icon: \'<path d="M12 2a6 6 0 0 0-3.5 10.9c.4.3.5.6.5 1.1V15h6v-1c0-.5.1-.8.5-1.1A6 6 0 0 0 12 2z"/><path d="M9 18h6"/><path d="M10 21h4"/>\',
    items: ["lanterns", "lantern_groups", "mgr_generating", "solar_panels"] },
  { name: "Augmenting Education", color: "#2563EB", bg: "#EEF3FE",
    icon: \'<path d="M4 5a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h6v16H5a1 1 0 0 1-1-1z"/><path d="M20 5a1 1 0 0 0-1-1h-6v16h6a1 1 0 0 0 1-1z"/>\',
    items: ["library", "library_books", "computers", "rachel", "starlink", "science_kits", "mgr_nongenerating", "construction", "rooms", "grow"] },
  { name: "Promoting Wellness", color: "#DC3545", bg: "#FDECEC",
    icon: \'<path d="M12 3.5s5.5 6 5.5 10.5a5.5 5.5 0 0 1-11 0C6.5 9.5 12 3.5 12 3.5z"/>\',
    items: ["menstrual_kits", "borehole", "toilets"] }
];

// Program-percentage bars (relocated from the Overview page)
var PROGRAM_COLS = [
  { key: "MGR", label: "Power-Generating MGR" },
  { key: "Non-Generating MGR", label: "Non-Generating MGR" },
  { key: "Feminine Hygiene Kits", label: "Feminine Hygiene Kits" },
  { key: "Science Kits", label: "Science Kits" },
  { key: "Library", label: "Library" },
  { key: "Computer", label: "Computer Lab" },
  { key: "Construction Projects", label: "Construction Projects" },
  { key: "Boreholes", label: "Boreholes" },
  { key: "Solar Power", label: "Solar Power" },
  { key: "Biofill Toilets", label: "Biofill Toilets" },
  { key: "Light a Village", label: "Light a Village" },
  { key: "Starlink", label: "Starlink" },
  { key: "GROW Project", label: "GROW Project" }
];

function catIcon(inner, color) {
  return \'<svg width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="\' + color + \'" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" style="flex:none;">\' + inner + \'</svg>\';
}

function inRange(dateStr, start, end) {
  if (!dateStr) return false;
  var d = dateStr.slice(0, 10);
  return d >= start && d <= end;
}

function tile(label, value, key, color, bg) {
  return \'<div class="output-tile" data-key="\' + key + \'" title="Click to see schools" style="background:\' + bg + \'; border-radius:8px; border-top:4px solid \' + color + \'; padding:1.2rem 1rem; box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); text-align:center; cursor:pointer; transition:transform 0.12s, box-shadow 0.12s;">\'
    + \'<span style="font-size:2rem; font-weight:700; color:var(--epi-navy); display:block; line-height:1.1;">\' + value.toLocaleString() + \'</span>\'
    + \'<span style="color:#555; font-size:0.85rem;">\' + label + \'</span></div>\';
}

function slugify(name) {
  return (name || "").toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-").replace(/-$/, "");
}

function openOutputModal(key) {
  var start = document.getElementById("imp-date-start").value;
  var end   = document.getElementById("imp-date-end").value;
  var rows = ITEMS.filter(function(it) { return it.item_key === key && inRange(it.project_date, start, end); });
  if (rows.length === 0) return;

  var bySchool = {};
  rows.forEach(function(it) {
    var s = it.school_name || "Unknown";
    bySchool[s] = (bySchool[s] || 0) + Number(it.quantity || 0);
  });
  var schools = Object.keys(bySchool).sort(function(a, b) {
    if (bySchool[b] !== bySchool[a]) return bySchool[b] - bySchool[a];
    return a.localeCompare(b);
  });

  document.getElementById("output-modal-title").textContent = rows[0].item_label || key;
  document.getElementById("output-modal-sub").textContent =
    schools.length + (schools.length === 1 ? " school" : " schools") + "  \\u00b7  " + start + " to " + end;

  var listHtml = "";
  schools.forEach(function(s) {
    listHtml += \'<div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; gap:1rem; padding:0.5rem 0; border-bottom:1px solid #f0f0f0;">\'
      + \'<a href="schools.html?school=\' + slugify(s) + \'" style="color:var(--epi-navy); text-decoration:none; border-bottom:1px dashed var(--epi-navy);">\' + s + \'</a>\'
      + \'<span style="font-weight:600; color:var(--epi-navy);">\' + bySchool[s].toLocaleString() + \'</span></div>\';
  });
  document.getElementById("output-modal-list").innerHTML = listHtml;
  document.getElementById("output-modal").style.display = "flex";
}

function closeOutputModal() {
  document.getElementById("output-modal").style.display = "none";
}

function renderOutputs() {
  var start = document.getElementById("imp-date-start").value;
  var end   = document.getElementById("imp-date-end").value;

  var filtered = ITEMS.filter(function(it) { return inRange(it.project_date, start, end); });

  var totals = {}, labels = {};
  filtered.forEach(function(it) {
    totals[it.item_key] = (totals[it.item_key] || 0) + Number(it.quantity || 0);
    labels[it.item_key] = it.item_label;
  });

  var html = "";
  CATEGORIES.forEach(function(cat) {
    var tilesHtml = "";
    cat.items.forEach(function(key) {
      if (totals[key] > 0) tilesHtml += tile(labels[key] || key, totals[key], key, cat.color, cat.bg);
    });
    if (tilesHtml === "") return;
    html += \'<h4 style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:0.5rem; color:var(--epi-navy); font-size:1.05rem; margin:1.5rem 0 0.75rem;">\' + catIcon(cat.icon, cat.color) + \'<span>\' + cat.name + \'</span></h4>\';
    html += \'<div style="display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill, minmax(150px, 1fr)); gap:1rem;">\' + tilesHtml + \'</div>\';
  });
  document.getElementById("outputs-container").innerHTML = html;
  document.getElementById("impact-empty").style.display = (html === "") ? "block" : "none";

  document.querySelectorAll(".output-tile").forEach(function(el) {
    el.addEventListener("click", function() { openOutputModal(el.getAttribute("data-key")); });
  });
}

function renderReach() {
  var canvas = document.getElementById("reach-chart");
  if (!canvas || typeof Chart === "undefined" || !REACH.years || REACH.years.length === 0) return;
  new Chart(canvas, {
    type: "line",
    data: {
      labels: REACH.years,
      datasets: [{
        data: REACH.counts,
        borderColor: "#1C2B4A",
        backgroundColor: "rgba(28,43,74,0.08)",
        fill: true,
        tension: 0.2,
        pointRadius: 3,
        pointBackgroundColor: "#F5B800",
        borderWidth: 2
      }]
    },
    options: {
      responsive: true,
      maintainAspectRatio: false,
      plugins: {
        legend: { display: false },
        tooltip: { callbacks: { label: function(ctx) { return ctx.raw + " schools"; } } }
      },
      scales: {
        y: { beginAtZero: true, ticks: { precision: 0 }, title: { display: true, text: "Schools" } },
        x: { grid: { display: false } }
      }
    }
  });
}

function renderProgramBars() {
  var el = document.getElementById("program-bars");
  if (!el || !PROGRAMS || PROGRAMS.length === 0) return;
  var total = PROGRAMS.length;
  var html = "";
  PROGRAM_COLS.forEach(function(prog) {
    var withProg = PROGRAMS.filter(function(s) { return Number(s[prog.key]) >= 1; }).length;
    var pct = Math.round((withProg / total) * 100);
    var barWidth = Math.max(pct, 3);
    html += \'<div style="display:flex; align-items:center; margin-bottom:0.4rem;">\'
      + \'<span style="width:180px; font-size:0.85rem;">\' + prog.label + \'</span>\'
      + \'<div class="program-bar" style="flex:1;"><div class="fill" style="width:\' + barWidth + \'%;">\' + pct + \'%</div></div></div>\';
  });
  el.innerHTML = html;
}

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
  renderReach();
  renderProgramBars();
  renderOutputs();
  document.getElementById("btn-imp-apply").addEventListener("click", renderOutputs);
  document.getElementById("btn-imp-reset").addEventListener("click", function() {
    var now = new Date();
    var syYear = now.getMonth() >= 7 ? now.getFullYear() : now.getFullYear() - 1;
    document.getElementById("imp-date-start").value = syYear + "-08-01";
    document.getElementById("imp-date-end").value = now.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    renderOutputs();
  });
});
</script>
'))
